# Kiguidev

> Kiguidev is the independent practice of Guillermo Obando, a web designer and front-end developer in Alajuela, Costa Rica. He designs and builds clear, responsive websites for local businesses and remote clients in the United States and abroad, working in English or Spanish.

## Services

- [Web Redesign](https://kiguidev.me/services/web-redesign/): review and redesign of outdated or hard-to-use websites
- [Web Development](https://kiguidev.me/services/web-development/): responsive business websites, landing pages and e-commerce
- [Mobile Enhancement](https://kiguidev.me/services/mobile-enhancement/): usability, accessibility and responsive fixes for existing sites
- [SEO](https://kiguidev.me/services/seo/): technical SEO, site structure, metadata and performance

## Case studies

- [All projects](https://kiguidev.me/projects/)
- [DeCorazonJoss](https://kiguidev.me/projects/decorazonjoss/): event decoration website
- [Meguis Import&Export](https://kiguidev.me/projects/meguis-import-export/): corporate logistics website
- [Stack Chef](https://kiguidev.me/projects/stack-chef/): AI developer tool
- [Kalta](https://kiguidev.me/projects/kalta/): marketing agency website
- [Eghee](https://kiguidev.me/projects/eghee/): product landing page
